thread:
Priya Patel: Quick sync — putting together the ownership matrix and SDK PR list for the v2 compatibility/deprecation window. Who's taking point on the Ruby + Node SDK updates?
Jordan Lee: I can take runtime compatibility validation (latency regressions, kernel selection checks) — will need the SDK PRs linked so we can run perf harness.
Marta Gomez: @Priya I can shepherd the Node SDK PRs (npm package + changelog). ETA for initial PRs: EOD Thu.
Alex Chen: I will own the Ruby SDK PRs and the migration guide updates. Planning to open the first PR tomorrow morning.
Samir Rao: Infra question — will the SDKs need any config changes for dedicated/private deployments (routing/prefix cache headers)? If so, we should surface to infra owners before canary.
Priya Patel: Good call @Samir. Alex/Marta, please flag any infra config surface area in your PR descriptions (headers, env flags). We'll loop infra owners for quick review.
Marta Gomez: Noted — Node PR will list: REDWOOD_CACHE_PREFIX, X-Region-Fallback header, and an opt-in adaptive-batching flag.
Alex Chen: Ruby PR will introduce a new client option: model_fallback_priority: [:latency, :cost]. No infra changes expected but will call out headers.
Jordan Lee: CI note — runtime test harness expects SDKs to support streaming chunked responses and tool-calling metadata. If PRs don't include that the automated perf tests will fail.
ci-bot: build/node-sdk#462 — tests: failed (streams): https://ci.internal/redwood/build/462 — see logs for chunking errors
Marta Gomez: Thanks @ci-bot. I see the failing test, will patch and force-push in ~45m.
Samir Rao: Rollout gating: suggest we require green e2e on Dedicated and Private matrices + a perf flag no-regress for 95th p95 tokens. Who sets the no-regress threshold?
Jordan Lee: I'll set the perf threshold and post the current baseline numbers to the perf docs after I run a small benchmark after Marta's patch.
Priya Patel: Owners summary: Node SDK = Marta, Ruby SDK = Alex, Runtime perf & thresholds = Jordan, Infra review = Samir. Action items: Marta/Alex open PRs w/ infra flags + migration guide snippets, Jordan runs baseline after PRs merge to canary, Samir triages infra review within 24h.
Alex Chen: Pinged @marta on the PR template we standardised for migration notes; will reuse.
Marta Gomez: Will tag infra and add a checklist to the PR (include sample config, rollback steps, canary route).
Priya Patel: Small ask — add the migration owner field to each PR body: "migration_owner: <display name>" so we can auto-generate the owner matrix.
Marta Gomez: Will do.
Alex Chen: Done for the Ruby PR (link coming).
ci-bot: build/ruby-sdk#301 — tests: passed ✅
Priya Patel: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the spreadsheet with owners and link the PRs once both are open. If anyone hits blockers DM me. :thumbsup:
Samir Rao: FYI I'll schedule a 15m gate review tomorrow 10:30 PT to clear infra questions before canary.
Jordan Lee: ETA on perf run after both SDKs are green: ~2 hours post-merge.
Marta Gomez: Node PR force-pushed, rerunning CI.
ci-bot: build/node-sdk#462 — tests: passed ✅
Priya Patel: OK closing the loop here — I'll post the final matrix after Samir's infra review. Thanks!
